parsed.note_claim: UK council tax law has no provision allowing homeowners to avoid council tax by using rooms for private prayer, regardless of religion.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It is not possible for owners of domestic property to avoid council tax by claiming that their property, or part of it, is used for religious purposes.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states the claim is false and quotes the House of Commons Library confirming no such exemption exists in council tax law.
